model: AI NVR 2 Value Form D 16 TB

storage.built_in: 16 TB effective (24 TB raw), RAID 5; OS on 2 x 32 GB microSD, RAID 1

power.supply: 100 to 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, auto-switching; single 450 W, non-hot-swappable and non-redundant

features: 10 GbE and teamed 1 GbE connections not supported
Classified Object Detection and AdaptAI on non-analytic cameras requires the optional analytics kit
No video outputs, web-based administration only
notes: Datasheet gives up to 90 channels at 550 Mbps (70 channels at 450 Mbps for the 16 TB model); the AI NVR 2 Value fact sheet and product page give up to 50 cameras.
Outgoing bandwidth is the stated livestream rate.
